The inflation outlook
Despite these increases in the CPIX, the inflation outlook over the coming months as well as over the longer term continues to be favourable.

Measured over a period of twelve months, the all-goods production price index has declined in every month since September 2003, but the rate of decline has moderated somewhat from 2,5 per cent in November 2003 to 1,0 per cent in February 2004.
